method: Independent model linguistic review of all 176 exact-source combined-form senses and all eleven lexical templates against every supplied English lexical alternative. Approvals are selected word-level inanimate direct-object readings, not universal translations, examples, native-human certification or actual coverage counts. Exact lemma-record and form-record hashes and sense indices remain binding. Only explicit single accusative lo/la/los/las with source-proved infinitive or positive imperative is authorized; retain object gender/number and source usage labels without inventing nouns, personal subjects, destinations or recipients. No suffix/accent decomposition, inferred se, dative or ambiguous personal object, multiclitic, negative command, indicative, participle or other finite expansion is authorized. Formal usted/ustedes command morphology must not become an indicative personal assertion.
